title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Surcharge Uplift for Packing Group I
content:
## Clause

Goods of the highest danger band attract an uplift of their own on the Dangerous Goods Acceptance loading surcharge. Where the acceptance declares packing group I, the category's packing-group I percentage applies; for packing groups II and III, and for goods declared without a packing group, this uplift is 0.

## Packing-group I percentage per category

| Category | Uplift when the packing group is I (percent) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 25 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 40 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 0 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 50 |

## Cases

| Category | Packing group declared | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | I | 40 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | II | 0 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | I | 50 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | none | 0 |
